about: Rarity weights ~ -log10(per-run likelihood) of one occurrence; scripts/rarity.py prices steps, mkmc --rarity K bounds a path's total. Tunable; timing-assumption escapes (slow*) are priced highest because real measurements show large margins (poc-h30/REPORT.md, ABORT_classified_completed.md).

actions_why.CommSJ_F.ClockAdvance: clock tick that enables timeouts; the timeout decision itself (MonitorSelect / ReportDeadClient) is charged
actions_why.CommSJ_F.WFCommClientIsActive: normal reaction (a live CJ's heartbeat clears a dead report)
actions_why.PayRcv_F.PullRetry: retry after a pull timeout that PullTimeout already charged
actions_why.JobSP_F.J2Exit: v8 multiJob: the other job runs minutes to hours, far longer than this job's start-up; its exit is a rare-timing event

weights_why.cancel: workflow cancel_task of outstanding tasks needs a non-default config (min_responses / timeout); stock FedAvg waits for all (poc-h30/REPORT.md)
weights_why.slowEnvelope: timing T3: a TASK_CHECK-approved envelope arrives within ~0.1 s, while close->save->finalize->END_RUN->DS shutdown takes >= 1.9 s (poc-h30/REPORT.md path 2)
weights_why.statusLost: L13: the SJ's single fire_and_forget status message is late (>2 s after exit) or lost; needs a degraded parent link
weights_why.spShutdown: admin shutdown/restart with jobs running: a routine operation, priced like abort (v9)
weights_why.slowShutdownAbort: timing escape T5: a registered client that does not reply makes each shutdown abort wait 2 s; priced like the other timing escapes (v9)
weights_why.workerCrash: task worker Pod exits nonzero without records (OOM kill, node loss): routine on GPU clusters (v10)
weights_why.workerFail: the task script or finalizer raises: failure.json, exit 1 (v10)
weights_why.taskStageFail: CJ cannot stage the attempt (disk full, PVC error) (v10)
weights_why.ctrlLoss: a CJ->CP k8s_task_control launch reply is lost or times out (v10)
weights_why.settleTimeout: CJ cannot confirm worker settlement within cleanup_timeout (API outage, stuck finalizer): fences the job (v10)
weights_why.acceptRaise: v11: aggregator.accept raises mid-loop (arithmetic / materialization); one bad contribution per run
weights_why.saveFail: v11: persistor save raises (disk full, I/O error)
weights_why.tpAttachLate: v11: the attach trainer is not started in time (operator action)
weights_why.tpCrash: v11: the attached trainer process dies
weights_why.tpReplyLost: v11: a control reply to the trainer is lost while the result transfer itself succeeded (needs selective loss)
weights_why.swarmMsgFail: v11: one peer-to-peer aux message fails or times out
weights_why.learnFail: v11: the local learn executor returns an error
weights_why.busyReplace: v11: a learn task arrives while the previous one is still running
weights_why.podDeleteFail: v11: the Kubernetes API rejects a Pod delete (H20)
weights_why.slowPublish: v11: a publish_results handler outlives its requester (H07: seconds-long handler window)
weights_why.sjSyncFail: v11: the SJ cannot reach SP for 30 s at start
weights_why.taskDataFail: v11: a task input download fails on the CJ
